q: ChatGPT keeps failing the animations. How should building and NPC animations be made?
ctx: The 64 px stills (pictures) pass every time, but the animations have failed 3 rounds for the 4 buildings (Kiln, Paper Mill, Workbench, Shrine glow) and 2 rounds for 6 of the 7 NPCs: instead of moving a part, ChatGPT repaints it as a flat shape or a checker pattern. In code, from the accepted stills, the game can do: glow pulses (Shrine gate, lanterns, hammer head), fire flicker and rising smoke (Kiln), water scroll, a paper sheet appearing, and small sways/nods. Moving a solid part (saw, wheel, an arm, armillary rings) needs that part as a separate layer: either ChatGPT draws the part on its own (much easier for it than animating) or we cut it out. Batches 1R3 and 2R2 are already requested on Drive; the answer decides whether they continue. The sheet shows every frame of this round (red = rejected).

imgs.cap: Round 3 review: frames, changed pixels (magenta) and in-game crops for all 10 files

o: Keep asking ChatGPT for hand-drawn animation frames (more repair rounds)
Animate the 4 buildings in code; keep asking ChatGPT for the NPC frames
Do glows, flicker, smoke, water and sways in code for all buildings and NPCs; ChatGPT draws only stills plus separate layers for parts that move (saw, wheel, arm, rings)
Everything in code, including moving parts that we cut out of the stills ourselves; ChatGPT draws stills only
No animation for now: ship the stills, revisit animation later
Mix: code for simple motion, ChatGPT layers where it works, our own cut-outs where it doesn't, and keep a hand-drawn round open for anything code can't do
